subject: Velox Supply — payment rail preference & remittance details
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <payments@veloxsupply.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: CFO Office <cfo@veloxsupply.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor — bank details & PO remittance format

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the warm welcome — Velox Supply is excited to get set up with Redwood. Attached is our bank authorization form and a sample remittance CSV we use for automated reconciliation. Quick notes:  

- Preferred rail: ACH (originating bank: First Cascade Bank, ABA 123456789). Wire fallback ok for urgent payments.
- Remittance reference: we include PO# in the invoice_number field and a separate remit_reference that should contain the Redwood PO (example: PO: RWD-4521).
- For large payouts we can accept wires; please indicate when wire routing is required.

Attachments: Velox_BANK_AUTH_FORM.pdf (bank letter + signed authorization), remit_sample_v1.csv

Next steps from our side: happy to complete any vendor portal steps or DocuSign requests. Please confirm if Redwood needs a micro-deposit to validate ACH.

Best,
Alex Moreno
Payments Lead — Velox Supply
payments@veloxsupply.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

[Attachment: Velox_BANK_AUTH_FORM.pdf]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <payments@veloxsupply.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor — bank details & PO remittance format

Alex — thank you for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few items from Redwood procurement/finops before we finalize:  

1) W-9: we need a W-9 on file for our accounting team to complete vendor onboarding. Can you attach that?
2) Micro-deposit: yes — our finance policy requires a micro-deposit verification for ACH to confirm account ownership unless a bank-letter is on file + KYC completed. Your bank letter helps, but we'll still run a single micro-deposit for confirmation unless you opt for a notarized bank letter.
3) PO mapping: good to see the sample CSV. Our invoices must include the Redwood PO exactly as RWD-#### in the invoice_number or invoice_reference field. We'll map that to our payables pipeline; please ask your billing team to include a single PO per invoice where possible to preserve automated matching.
4) DocuSign: please sign the vendor banking authorization if not already done — we can ingest signed forms via DocuSign link.

Next actions from Redwood: Marissa (cc'd) will provision a virtual remit code (single-use reference) for Velox to be included on the first invoice so accounting can auto-tag the pay-run. Priyom from FinOps will schedule the ACH micro-deposit and confirm amount/time.

Can you send the W-9 and confirm who will sign DocuSign (name & email)? Once we have the W-9 and the signed bank auth we should be able to complete onboarding within 2 business days post micro-deposit clearance.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Procurement
Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0147
